title: Latin hypercubes with restricted transversals
summary: A $k$-plane of a $d$-dimensional array is a subarray formed by fixing $d-k$ coordinates and allowing the remaining $k$ coordinates to vary freely. A Latin hypercube of dimension $d$ and order $n$ is an $n\times n\times\cdots\times n$ array of dimension $d$ containing symbols from an $n$-set, such that each $1$-plane contains each of the possible entries exactly once. A transversal in a Latin hypercube of order $n$ is a set of $n$ entries of the hypercube, no pair of which agree in any coordinate or contain the same symbol.
